people.line: Ndị ị na-ezigara ọrụ na ihe {name} mere, ndị na-ejikwa {name}, ndị ị na-enweta azịza ha. Naanị ha nwere ike imeghe ihe ị zigaara ha.
people.none: Ọ dịbeghị onye. Tinye onye nọ n’akụkụ gị site na koodu ọ ga-enyocha, ma ọ bụ onye nọ ebe ọzọ site na njikọ.
people.nobody: Ọ dịbeghị onye nwere aha ahụ na nzukọ gị na-eji {name}.
people.mailSubject: Ka anyị jiri {name} na-ezigara ibe anyị ọrụ
people.mailBody: Ana m eji {name} n’ọrụ, anyị nwere ike iji ya na-ezigara ibe anyị ọrụ. Mepee njikọ a ma banye na akaụntụ ọrụ gị: {link}
people.joined: {name} na-eji {app} ugbu a. Unu nwere ike ịna-ezigara ibe unu ọrụ.
people.ways: Koodu mgbe ha nọ n’akụkụ gị, njikọ mgbe ha nọ ebe ọzọ.
people.qr: Akwụkwọ ịkpọ oku dị ka koodu QR, maka igwefoto ekwentị ha
people.point: Ha ga-atụ igwefoto ekwentị ha n’elu koodu ahụ, ma ọ bụ mepee njikọ ahụ. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ ma nke a ka mepere emepe.
people.week: Ziga ya otu ị na-esi ezigara ha ihe ọ bụla ọzọ. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ otu izu.
people.typeCode: Ọnụọgụ isii {name} na-egosi gị ma ọ bụ zighachiri

people.wrong.other: Ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ adakọghị. Ọnwụnwa {count} fọdụrụ.

people.added: {name} nọ n’etiti ndị gị. Ozugbo ha zara, unu nwere ike ịna-ezigara ibe unu ọrụ.
people.accepted: Mmadụ anabatala akwụkwọ ịkpọ oku gị maka {name}. Pịnye ọnụọgụ isii ha zighachiri gị.
people.again: Ịhụ ọzọ: igodo ha gbanwere n’ụzọ a na-enweghị ike inyocha
people.remove: Wepụ {name}? Ihe ha zigaara gị ka bụ nke gị.
people.invited: Mmadụ na-akpọ gị ka unu jiri {name} na-ezigara ibe unu ọrụ.
people.seen: Ha ga-ahụ aha profaịlụ a na-aza.
people.showCode: Gosi onye nọ n’akụkụ gị ọnụọgụ ndị a, ma ọ bụ zighachi ha otu akwụkwọ ịkpọ oku si bịa
people.metThem: {name} nọ n’etiti ndị gị ugbu a. Unu nwere ike ịna-ezigara ibe unu ọrụ.
people.words: Okwu ole na ole maka ha
people.size: {size}, n’ime {limit} nwere ike ịga otu mgbe
people.why.waiting: Ha azabeghị. Ozugbo ha zara, ị nwere ike iziga ha ihe.
people.why.large: Nke a buru ibu iziga. Na-enweghị ihe {name} gụrụ, ma ọ bụ otu akụkụ ya, ọ nwere ike ịdaba.
people.why.unreached: Nke a erughị ha. Lelee njikọ ma nwaa ọzọ.
people.why.link: Nke a abụghị njikọ akwụkwọ ịkpọ oku. Rịọ ya ọzọ.
people.why.used: E jirila akwụkwọ ịkpọ oku a. Rịọ nke ọhụrụ.
people.why.gone: A kwụsịrị akwụkwọ ịkpọ oku a ma ọ bụ oge ya agaala. Rịọ nke ọhụrụ.
people.why.self: Nke a bụ akwụkwọ ịkpọ oku nke gị. Ziga ya nye onye nke ọzọ.
people.why.known: Onye a anọlarị n’etiti ndị gị.
people.why.tries: Ọnwụnwa atọ na-ezighị ezi: ọ kwụsịrị, maka nchekwa. Malite ọzọ.
people.why.relay: Enweghị ike iru nke a ugbu a. Lelee njikọ ma nwaa ọzọ.
people.why.refused: Nzukọ gị anaghị ekwe ka ị ruo onye a.
people.why.inside: Nzukọ gị na-atinye mmadụ site na ndepụta ya. Chọta ha site n’aha kama.
people.why.broken: Ihe adịghị mma mere. Nwaa ọzọ.
people.invites: {name} na-akpọ gị ka unu rụkọọ ọrụ na “{title}”
people.nudge: Ihe bịaara gị. Mepee {name} ka ị hụ ya.
